copy.tagline: 集成 Microsoft Teams 频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Teams 消息通知功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Microsoft Teams channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Teams messaging to your application

howto.what: 为项目添加 Microsoft Teams 渠道支持:复制并注册 Teams 适配器,安装固定版本依赖,执行构建和测试;然后用 Teams CLI 创建机器人、把凭据写入 .env、设置图标,引导安装应用到 Teams 并关联账号。
howto.when: 当用户要求为项目接入 Microsoft Teams 时触发;需要公网 HTTPS 地址和 Microsoft 365 账号。若检测到已有 Teams 凭据,会跳过创建机器人等步骤。

say.text: 给这个项目加上 Teams 渠道集成
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册、安装依赖并构建测试

say.text: 重跑 Teams 设置,保留现有凭据
say.note: 已有凭据时跳过创建,直接继续

howto.what_en: Adds Microsoft Teams chat support via the Chat SDK: copies the adapter, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, builds and tests, then uses the Teams CLI to create a bot, store credentials, set icons, install the app, and wire it to a user.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add Microsoft Teams integration. Requires an HTTPS public URL and a Microsoft 365 account. If credentials already exist in .env, the creation steps are skipped.

say_en.text: Add Teams messaging support to this project.
say_en.note: Copies adapter, registers, installs, builds, tests.

say_en.text: Set up Teams bot with URL https://example.com and name mybot.
say_en.note: Uses the provided URL and name.

say_en.text: Re-run Teams setup without overwriting existing credentials.
